name: revxl-marketplace
description: REVXL's curated catalog of Claude superengines — opinionated, multi-skill plugins built for real coaching businesses. One install, per-plugin picker, auto-updates.

plugins.name: course-crawler
plugins.description: Capture any online content as a clean local archive for knowledge bases. Single pages, full multi-lesson courses (Kajabi/Teachable/Thinkific/Skool classrooms/custom), and YouTube playlists. Detects the agentic browser you have, handles login (assisted or manual cookie paste), and outputs clean Markdown + categorized reference links + downloaded assets + slide frames + transcripts. Local GPU Whisper by default (Groq/OpenAI fallback). Works on Mac and Windows.

plugins.name: workspace-superengine
plugins.description: Stops Claude from forgetting what you were working on. Sets up your workspace so every session picks up where the last one left off, follows your rules, and explains itself in plain language. Add modules for coding, client work, or content as needed. Works in Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

plugins.name: ghl-coach-superengine
plugins.description: GoHighLevel done-with-you toolkit for health/wellness/fitness coaches. 8 skills + 2 agents that build and maintain a persistent 13-file per-coach workspace, refresh it from GHL on every session, surface what needs attention, and execute multi-step work via MCP. Requires the GoHighLevel-MCP (mastanley13) and Filesystem MCP.

plugins.name: offer-architect
plugins.description: Build market-validated, Hormozi-structured coaching offers — start to finish. 10 skills + 1 audit agent take a coach from intake → deep market research → value stack → pricing matrix → finalized offer → a 3–5 page Offer Blueprint (the coach's source of truth) + a Projected Success Score report (0–100 launch-readiness with plain-English priority fixes). Two-layer scoring: preventive exit-checks at every step + capstone audit. Hard rule on no-inventing-deliverables via provenance tags.

plugins.name: notebooklm-superengine
plugins.description: Gets Google NotebookLM working on your computer and keeps it working. One guided setup handles the install and Google sign-in — the part that usually breaks — on Mac or Windows. Then build research notebooks, ask them questions, and turn them into podcasts and study guides just by talking to Claude. Local-only: no servers, tunnels, or extra accounts.

plugins.name: gokollab-community-superengine
plugins.description: One-install community automation for clientclub / GoHighLevel (GoKollab) coaches. Onboard new members by tier (approve → add to the right channels → build their private 1:1 channel → welcome posts), turn group-call recordings into featured recap posts, and keep each client's 1:1 call history current — all by talking to Claude. Self-installs its dependencies and captures your own community login at setup. No terminal.

plugins.name: sales-call-blueprint-superengine
plugins.description: Paste the DM thread behind a booked call, get back a psychology-driven blueprint for it. Triage (15-min qualifier) or strategy (RFPDP closing) calls, as a deep prep doc or a live call-time card. Pulls prior-call transcripts (Fathom/Fireflies/Granola/GHL/manual), delivers to Google Drive / local / GHL note, and batches many prospects at once via its agent. Your pricing stays yours — supplied live, never stored. For coaches and the people who take their sales calls.

plugins.name: email-sequence-superengine
plugins.description: Run one setup, then generate voice-matched broadcast email sequences for your high-ticket coaching program: pre-call show-up, launch, warm nurture, no-show recovery, post-call follow-up, win-back, onboarding, and a pre-sell VSL script. Built once, fires to everyone (personalization is merge tokens, never invented facts), with a storytelling engine, pitch-floor controls, a voice-edge dial, and ESP-agnostic output plus optional GoHighLevel push. Drafts only, it never sends. For coaches who want their list nurtured in their own voice.

plugins.name: shortform-superengine
plugins.description: Turn competitor research into Instagram reel scripts in your own voice. One guided setup, then by talking to Claude: cross-reference your reels against tiered competitors for a 10-section strategy roadmap, harvest a trusted creator's whole library into a framework corpus, and script reels off what already wins in your niche (Hook to CTA, with craft scoring). Bring-your-own SocialCrawl key (your data, your credits); captions-first transcription with Groq or local Whisper fallback; plain-English teach mode by default. For coaches who want data-driven short-form that still sounds like them.

plugins.name: socialcrawl-superengine
plugins.description: Deep social research superengine on the SocialCrawl API: the full 43-platform / 333-endpoint canon with exact per-call credits, plus guided research plays — voice-of-customer mining, competitor ad-library recon, AI-visibility (GEO) audits, link-in-bio offer mapping, audience demographics, dev/tool radar — and hard-gated big-gun one-shots (creator vetting, lead discovery, share-of-voice). Bring-your-own key; every paid call is cost-gated up front. Pairs with the RevXL format engines (they detect it and unlock deep plays) or runs standalone.

plugins.name: plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Fixes stalled Claude plugin updates. Diagnoses whether a plugin is stuck on an old version or hitting the in-app directory 404, then fixes it: runs the staged, reversible marketplace-updater script for you (or walks the manual fix), with config-safety guarantees - your plugin data and brand config are never touched. One command: /plugin-doctor.
